About Xanadu:

Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere.



At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. What we are doing is extremely hard, the classic moon shot. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. And that is something to be excited about!

Senior AI Engineer
Senior Full-Stack Engineer at Perceptic: own end-to-end AI-powered workflows for drug discovery, from frontend to data and APIs, delivering trustworthy, production-grade AI.

Apply for this job
We usually respond within a week

The highest calling for AI is improving human health. At Perceptic, we're building the AI operating system that powers drug discovery - a unified intelligence layer that connects evidence, reasoning, and action across the entire drug lifecycle.

We were built by operators from Palantir who spent years deploying production AI in the world's most demanding enterprise environments. We know what it takes to make ambitious technology hold up under real pressure. Now we're applying that to pharma and we're hiring engineers who've operated at the same standard.

We are hiring Senior AI Engineers who have shipped real AI product experiences. We mean people who have built AI products, broken them in production, fixed them, and shipped them to users who depend on the result. Curiosity about AI isn't enough.

The hard problem here is getting AI to reason over the world's scientific evidence well enough that a pharma scientist will stake a major decision on the result. That takes agents doing substantive work, surfaced through interfaces that make their reasoning easy to follow and check.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the front end, Java and Python services behind it, and an agent layer built on durable, fault-tolerant workflows that reason over scientific data through a growing set of tools and integrations. We keep the technology choices few and high-leverage, and you'll work across all of them.

What you'll own

End-to-end product features across the frontend, backend, data, and API layers, owned through to production

AI-powered scientific workflows: agentic systems, retrieval, tool use, and the evaluation loops that keep them honest

The integration work that turns model providers and AI tooling into product experiences people can depend on

Evaluation and feedback systems that make AI behavior measurable and improvable over time

Trust surfaces such as provenance, citations, and confidence, rendered so a scientist can check the work behind any answer

Close work with founders, customers, and domain experts, turning ambiguity into shipped product

Engineering velocity through automation, AI-assisted development, and internal tooling that lets a small team do the work of a much larger one

What we're looking for

At least 4+ years of professional engineering experience, with broad full-stack range

You've shipped AI features that people rely on, and you can point to them

You can talk concretely about prompts, evals, failure modes, latency, cost, and the UX tradeoffs of building with language models

You use AI coding tools fluently and have strong, earned opinions about where they help and where they fall down

You've come from somewhere that held a high bar, such as FAANG, a top AI lab, or a respected product-engineering environment

You want more ownership, speed, and upside than those environments tend to offer

You have strong product taste and can make pragmatic calls without waiting for perfect requirements

This is a high-intensity, high-stakes role. We move quickly and give direct feedback, the responsibility you carry will likely outrun your title, and you'll go wherever the company needs you most, which sometimes means unglamorous work that matters more than anything else that week. The people who do well here find that kind of ownership and growth exciting, and they weren't looking for a nine-to-five.

ABOUT US

Procurify is the AI-enhanced procurement and AP automation platform for mid-market organizations. We make it easy for organizations to take control of spend and save money.

We’re looking for a pragmatic and thoughtful engineering leader to help scale our platform, development practices, and team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer II to join our team and help build the core engine and user experiences that power the Procurify platform. You will be a key contributor across both backend and frontend systems—working on everything from complex business logic and APIs to polished, high-performance user interfaces.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and other engineers to solve challenging technical problems and ship high-quality features end to end. You’ll need to be passionate about building reliable backend systems and intuitive, scalable frontend applications, and eager to grow your skills in a fast-paced, modern cloud environment.

Everyone at Procurify is a team player. A big part of this role involves a desire for personal growth and a customer-centric mindset. We’re seeking entrepreneurial people who are willing to challenge the status quo and contribute to larger strategic objectives.

WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

Build & Ship End-to-End Features: Design, develop, and maintain full stack features—from RESTful APIs and backend services to responsive, user-friendly frontend components—using Python/Django and TypeScript/React.

Develop Scalable Backend Services: Build and evolve backend systems that handle business logic, data storage, and integrations, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability.

Create High-Quality Frontend Experiences: Implement reusable, accessible, and performant UI components in React. Collaborate with product and design to deliver intuitive user experiences.

Design & Optimize Database Schemas: Contribute to the design of our database models and write efficient, secure queries. You will work to ensure the performance and integrity of our data layer.

Champion Code Quality: Contribute clean, efficient, testable, and reusable code that is easy to maintain and extend. You will actively participate in code reviews, sharing your knowledge and providing constructive feedback to elevate the team.

Strengthen System Architecture: Collaborate with your team on technical designs to ensure they follow appropriate patterns and are architecturally sound. You will help improve the implementation and architecture of our backend systems.

Ensure System Reliability: Participate in the investigation and resolution of defects, performance bottlenecks, and any other issues affecting the quality and stability of the monolith.

Our Tech Stack:

Application: Python/Django, Typescript/React

Cloud: AWS

Infrastructure & Containers: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform

Databases: MySQL

CI/CD: CircleCI

Lead With CARES:
Commitment: Demonstrates accountability and follow-through, delivering reliably and owning outcomes in a way that others can depend on.

Ambition: Takes initiative with curiosity and a growth mindset, pursuing bold ideas that elevate impact and performance.

Resilience: Shows adaptability, composure, and perseverance through challenges, staying focused and effective in a fast-changing environment.

Excellence: Brings rigor, collaboration, and a strong quality focus to deliver high-performing solutions and raise the bar for outcomes.

Simplicity: Applies focus, clarity, and streamlining to cut through complexity and enable efficient, impactful execution.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Full Stack Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in hands-on work across both frontend and backend systems, preferably in a SaaS environment.

AI Tool Proficiency: Daily use of tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to streamline coding tasks, generate documentation, and scaffold features.

Python Proficiency: Strong experience building and maintaining applications using Python and a major web framework (we use Django).

React: Experience building modern web applications with React and TypeScript, including component-based architecture and state management.

Agile & Collaborative: Experience working with agile practices (Scrum/Kanban) and CI/CD principles. You thrive in a team environment.

Empathetic & Accountable: You act with compassion, believe that your team’s success is your success, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

What Makes Procurify a Great Place to Work for Engineers
A modern tech stack with opportunities to influence future architecture.

A culture committed to learning, experimentation, and engineering excellence.

Clear technical vision and empowered teams who own their outcomes.

Genuine collaboration, psychological safety, and a people-first culture.

Meaningful problems to solve with real customer and business impact.

WHY PROCURIFY?

We’re committed to helping mission-driven organizations spend smarter

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re looking for talented and team-driven individuals to join us on our journey to build a place where the best people want to work – a place where every team member is empowered to apply their best thinking, push boundaries thoughtfully, and drive high performance together.

Master's Degree

1–2+ years of software engineering experience (strong new grads with relevant internships/projects welcome).
Depth in frontend development with React, Redux, and TypeScript, and comfort working across the stack.
Working proficiency in [backend language — e.g., Go, Java, C++, or another statically typed language], enough to make changes in the identity backend.
Solid CS fundamentals and a growing understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native development.
Interest in or exposure to security and identity concepts (authN/authZ, SSO/OIDC/SAML, encryption, common vulnerability classes, secure coding).
Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and work closely with mentors.
Strong communication, collaboration, and ownership of your tasks.
You have a frontend craft mindset — you care about UX quality, performance, and maintainable component architecture — while being comfortable dipping into the identity backend when a feature needs it.
You bring a security-first mindset — careful, detail-oriented, and curious about how things can go wrong.
You're eager to learn a domain deeply and become the trusted owner of a component.
You take pride in delivering well-scoped work reliably and on time.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

coursework, internships, certifications, CTF/security-project experience, or exposure to identity, cryptography, or cloud security

About the job
About us


Surrey Bailiffs Ltd. is a licensed repossession and bailiff company agency in British Columbia. We're a small team with outsized ambition. Fast-growing, operationally driven, and increasingly powered by software we build ourselves. At the centre of our business is a proprietary, web-based operations platform that runs how we track files, coordinate field bailiffs, and manage the work end to end.

We've reached the point where software is no longer a side project, it's a core driver of how we scale. This is a newly defined role, and the person who fills it will shape it.



The role


This is the only developer role in the company, and it's built for someone who wants exactly that.

You'll own our operational software: Maintaining it, improving it, and extending it as the business grows. Beyond the platform itself, you'll work directly with the people running the business to understand how the company actually operates, then find and build the automation that makes it run better. There's no backlog handed to you and no tickets to pull. You'll be expected to look at how we work, form your own view on what's worth doing, and make the case for it.

If you're a strong developer who has felt boxed in by narrow tickets and wants real ownership and visible impact across an entire business, this is that opportunity.



What you'll do


Own, maintain, and improve our proprietary operations platform (a React single-page application backed by a web API and database).
Sit down with business managers, understand the high-level picture, and translate operational needs into working software with no business analysts or product owners in between.
Review existing workflows across the company to spot inefficiencies and design automation that removes manual, repetitive work.
Use AI tools thoughtfully to build faster, automate intelligently, and create capabilities that weren't practical before.
Server Management - Migrate existing platform to new server provider, manage logs, disk space, and performance
Make independent resource and technical decisions and own the outcomes. This includes architecture, supporting software and tools, priorities, future team members, etc.
Ship reliably and keep a production system that the business depends on every day running smoothly.


Who you are


Mid-level full stack experience. Roughly 3-6 years building and shipping real production web applications, comfortable across the frontend and backend. Solid with modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React; able to design APIs, model data, and work with databases. Knowledge in Linux server administration.
Genuinely autonomous. You're energized, not unsettled, by being the only developer. You can prioritize your own work, unblock yourself, and deliver without someone managing the details.
Curious about and experienced with AI tools. You actively use AI in how you build, and you're interested in where it can take the business. You treat it as a serious capability, not a novelty.
Business-minded. You can hold a conversation with a business manager, grasp the high-level view, and connect technical decisions to what actually matters operationally and commercially. You care about why something is being built, not just how.
A clear communicator. You can explain technical trade-offs in plain language and bring non-technical leadership along with you.
Pragmatic and outcome-driven. You ship things that work and create value, and you know when "good enough and live" beats "perfect and delayed."


Nice to have


Experience building or maintaining internal/operational tools rather than consumer products.
Background working in a small business or startup where you wore multiple hats.
Exposure to workflow automation, integrations, or process tooling.
Familiarity with the kind of compliance common in legal, financial, or regulated industries.

Why this role is different


Total ownership. This is your software and your domain, not a slice of someone else's roadmap.
Real impact, visible fast. What you build is used by the business immediately, and you'll see the difference it makes.
A seat at the table. You'll work directly with leadership and have a genuine voice in where the company's expansion leads and the technology that supports it.
Room to grow with us. We're ambitious and growing quickly. The person who builds the foundation has the chance to grow into far more.


The details


Full-time  and fully remote - work from wherever you do your best work.
Independent, self-directed environment with direct access to business leadership.
Salary based on experience

About Dialpad

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic.

Your role

We are seeking an experienced and ambitious Full Stack Software Engineer passionate about building high-quality, large-scale web and desktop-native applications using modern frontend and backend technologies. You will take end-to-end ownership of significant features, driving architectural decisions, tackling complex technical hurdles, and ensuring high code quality. Your expertise will enrich the team, including through the active mentorship of junior engineers. You will proactively collaborate with Product Managers and cross-functional partners to advocate for technical initiatives that improve team efficiency, system stability, and long-term maintainability.

This position reports to our Engineering Manager and is looking for someone to join the team in our Vancouver, Canada, Office.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and deploy high-quality features across Dialpad's web and desktop-native applications.
Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using best practices along with unit & integration tests.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and scalability.
Ensure that features are shipped on time and with the highest quality.
Participate in a rotating team on-call schedule to quickly diagnose and resolve critical issues, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and use common components and practices across Dialpad products.
Partner closely with Product, Growth, and cross-functional stakeholders to build and optimize monetization, signup, onboarding, activation, and expansion experiences across Dialpad products.
Develop experimentation and feature-flagging capabilities that enable rapid iteration, A/B testing, and data-driven product decisions.
Build scalable platform capabilities that empower other teams to launch and iterate on growth initiatives efficiently and safely.
Design and implement solutions that improve conversion, customer adoption, retention, and operational efficiency while maintaining high reliability and performance.
Leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve operational insights, and enhance customer-facing experiences.
Mentor junior engineers and help them grow their skills and expertise.

Skills You’ll Bring

Strong experience with Python, Vue/React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, GraphQL, GCP, or other cloud infrastructures.
Practical experience designing, deploying, and optimizing solutions leveraging serverless computing, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
Proficiency with both SQL and NoSQL databases.
Experience with building reusable and modular components for both frontend and backend.
Experience with RESTful APIs and GraphQL schemas.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
Proven ability to design, build, launch, and maintain at least two large-scale production systems.
Experience with Agile development methodologies.
Experience leveraging modern AI-powered developer tools and workflows (e.g., LLM-assisted development, code generation, debugging, and productivity tooling) to improve engineering efficiency and software quality.
Familiarity with integrating AI/LLM-based capabilities into applications, including prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted user experiences, or third-party AI platform integrations, is a plus.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

applications.title: Software Engineer (Growth)

applications.jd:
About the job
Opportunity

Method is the operating system thousands of small businesses run their day on — purpose-built for QuickBooks and Xero users who have outgrown spreadsheets and generic tools. Our no-code customization engine lets customers design workflows that fit their business, and we’re now layering AI on top to help them build and automate those workflows faster than ever.

The Growth team owns the moment that matters most: turning a curious signup into a committed subscriber. We work on the top-of-funnel journey — signup, onboarding, activation, and billing — running continuous experiments to improve conversion at every step. Everything we do is in service of one goal: increasing the percentage of signups that subscribe.

We’re looking for an Intermediate Full-Stack Developer who wants to ship work that moves real metrics for real businesses, and who already works AI-first in their craft.

The Role

You’ll join a focused, cross-functional Growth team. Your work lives in the top-of-funnel stack: signup UI, account API, analytics, billing, onboarding, and subscription — systems that directly affect whether a new user stays or leaves.

As an Intermediate Full-Stack Developer, you’ll operate with periodic review and coaching from your manager and team lead, own implementation decisions within approved experiment scope, and grow toward stronger autonomy over time.

Ship experiment variations end-to-end across React / TypeScript and .NET Core — from hypothesis to production.
Work across the full user journey — the systems that bring new users in, get them to value, and keep them subscribed.
Contribute to improving the early customer experience, helping users find value in the product as quickly as possible.
Support a data-driven team by helping instrument and monitor the features you build.
Operate in an AI-native planning → execution → verification loop: use AI to understand requirements, generate and refactor code, and validate before shipping. Own what you ship.
Write automated tests alongside your implementations, working closely with QA to meet quality standards.
Collaborate closely with your team across planning, delivery, and regular cross-functional touchpoints.
Escalate early when experiment scope expands, architecture is affected, customer data integrity is at risk, or AI-generated output can’t be safely verified.

What You Bring

We know the ideal candidate doesn’t exist. If you don’t check every box, we’d still love to hear from you — growth potential is real here. That said, the AI-first bar, trust-and-verify judgment, and customer-trust instinct are non-negotiable regardless of background.

3+ years building and shipping production web applications across front-end and back-end.
Strong backend fundamentals in C# / .NET Core, or equivalent in Java, Node, or a comparable stack.
Strong frontend fundamentals in React / TypeScript, or equivalent in Angular or Vue.
Experience with relational and / or NoSQL persistence and ORM.
Solid grasp of API design, real-world debugging, and writing clean, maintainable code.
Hands-on experience with unit and integration testing as a first-class part of delivery.
Comfortable with experiment-driven development: shipping lean MVPs, reading results, and iterating.
Comfortable with tasks with clear direction and close coaching; communicates trade-offs and uncertainty clearly.
AI-first in your daily workflow (Codex, Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) with the engineering judgment to understand and own what you ship.
Sprint / Kanban or ScrumBan experience in an Agile environment

Bonus Points If You Have Any Of The Following

Experience with product analytics tools — Amplitude, Datadog, or similar.
Familiarity with A / B testing infrastructure, feature flagging, or experimentation frameworks.
Experience with billing or subscription systems.
Experience with no-code or low-code platforms, or products built around configurability.
Linux, Docker, Redux, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, MassTransit, CI / CD pipeline, Python, AWS.
Microsoft or AWS certifications.

applications.title: Intermediate Full-Stack Developer

applications.jd:
About the job
About Jetson

Jetson is on a mission to accelerate the transition of 100 million homes across North America away from fossil fuels toward sustainable energy use. We believe in a future that is 100% electric and 100% better.

Homes are one of the largest sources of carbon emissions, yet adoption of solutions like heat pumps remains slow due to cost and complexity. Jetson is solving this by building the first fully vertically integrated home electrification company — making clean energy simple, transparent, and affordable.

We rely heavily on technology, automation, and data to scale this impact. At Jetson, we value people who are excellent at their craft, curious about new tools (including AI), and motivated to continuously improve how work gets done.

The Opportunity

We're building a new kind of role to help us scale: the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE). The title was originally coined for engineers embedded with external customers, and we've pointed that model inward. As an FDE on our Finance team, your customers are Jetson's own teams. You'll sit with them, learn their work deeply, and build the agents, tools, and automations that change how they operate.

Instead of routing every request through a central engineering backlog, we put engineers inside the teams that need help. You hear the problem firsthand, build the fix, and iterate the next day. FDEs across functions build on a shared internal platform alongside core engineering, so every automation you ship makes the next one faster. The more we deploy, the faster we can deploy.

Who You Are

A builder who ships. Strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment, and a drive to get things into people's hands. You're fluent in TypeScript, Python, or other high-level language, comfortable with SQL, APIs, and cloud tooling, and you write code others can build on. You value breadth and speed over deep specialization.
An excellent communicator. This is what separates the role from a typical SWE job and brings it closer to a PM. You can sit with accounting, FP&A, and leadership stakeholders, draw out what they actually need (often not what they first asked for), explain tradeoffs, and drive a project to adoption.
A fast learner who's excited by the domain. You're energized by getting deep into how Finance works: its workflows, systems, and constraints. Familiarity with financial workflows like close, reporting, or FP&A, or with an ERP (we use NetSuite), is a plus, but what matters more is the drive and ability to learn it fast. You ask good questions, make reasonable assumptions, handle sensitive data with care, and iterate as reality pushes back.
AI-native. AI is core to how you build, not a novelty. You use tools like Claude Code or Cursor to move faster, and you know when to trust the model and when to push back. You've built agentic and LLM-powered features, and you understand the real challenges: latency, cost, reliability, evaluation, and graceful failure.
Comfortable without a playbook. You thrive where the problem isn't fully defined. You'd rather ship something useful this week and improve it than perfect it for a quarter. You measure yourself by whether the team is faster and more capable because of what you built, not by lines of code.

What You’ll Do

Embed and learn the domain. Sit with the team and build real fluency in how Finance runs across a multi-entity business spanning the US and Canada: the monthly close and its reconciliations, financial and management reporting, rebate accounting, AP/AR, and FP&A. This is the core of the job, not background context.
Build agents that automate real work. Find finance workflows that AI agents can handle or accelerate, then design, build, and ship them. For example, an agent that assembles the monthly close checklist and flags anomalies, or one that reconciles rebate flows end to end. Know where an agent earns its keep versus where a simple script is cheaper and more reliable.
Connect systems and keep data flowing. Much of the team's friction is manual handoffs between systems. You'll build and maintain integrations and automations that keep financial data flowing accurately between NetSuite, spreadsheets, and Jetson's data platform, so the numbers reconcile and reporting stops being a manual pull.
Build dashboards and tools. Give Finance and leadership clear, real-time visibility: margin by market and by job, cash position and AR/AP aging, budget-versus-actual, and a live view of where the close stands. Replace recurring hand-maintained spreadsheets with live dashboards and tools.
Always be scoping. Question requirements directly with the team. The best solution is often smaller than the original ask, or solves the real problem another way. Ship value now, iterate from there.
Generalize into the platform. Push reusable capabilities into the shared internal platform alongside other FDEs and core engineering, rather than piling up one-off scripts. Weigh hacking something for Finance today against building something ten teams use tomorrow.

How You Will Grow

Become a rare kind of engineer. Few people can connect a messy real-world domain, the data under it, and software people actually adopt. You'll build exactly that profile, which is one of the most valuable in the industry right now.
See the whole business. Embedded in Finance and plugged into the core platform, you'll understand how Jetson works end to end, with a front-row seat to the economics of the business. That makes you a stronger engineer and a sharper decision-maker.
Help define a new discipline at Jetson. We're early in understanding how AI changes what a small team can do. You'll set the patterns, platform, and standards for how forward deployed engineering works here.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: We are open to considering candidates at several levels. Our compensation is structured to meet or exceed the market standard.

Benefits:

Dental Care, Vision Care & Life Insurance premiums fully paid by Jetson
Extended Health Care
Disability Insurance
Education Support
Parental Leave Top Up
Equity

Work Location: In person - North Vancouver, BC

Do you feel like you don't have everything that's listed above but can still do the job? If you have the core skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply!

Canada Roles Jetson is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusive hiring. We do not discriminate on any ground protected under applicable human rights legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

The title was originally coined for engineers embedded with external customers, and we've pointed that model inward. As an FDE on our Finance team, your customers are Jetson's own teams. You'll sit with them, learn their work deeply, and build the agents, tools, and automations that change how they operate.

Instead of routing every request through a central engineering backlog, we put engineers inside the teams that need help. You hear the problem firsthand, build the fix, and iterate the next day. FDEs across functions build on a shared internal platform alongside core engineering, so every automation you ship makes the next one faster. The more we deploy, the faster we can deploy.

Who You Are

A builder who ships. Strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment, and a drive to get things into people's hands. You're fluent in TypeScript, Python, or other high-level language, comfortable with SQL, APIs, and cloud tooling, and you write code others can build on. You value breadth and speed over deep specialization.
An excellent communicator. This is what separates the role from a typical SWE job and brings it closer to a PM. You can sit with accounting, FP&A, and leadership stakeholders, draw out what they actually need (often not what they first asked for), explain tradeoffs, and drive a project to adoption.
A fast learner who's excited by the domain. You're energized by getting deep into how Finance works: its workflows, systems, and constraints. Familiarity with financial workflows like close, reporting, or FP&A, or with an ERP (we use NetSuite), is a plus, but what matters more is the drive and ability to learn it fast. You ask good questions, make reasonable assumptions, handle sensitive data with care, and iterate as reality pushes back.
AI-native. AI is core to how you build, not a novelty. You use tools like Claude Code or Cursor to move faster, and you know when to trust the model and when to push back. You've built agentic and LLM-powered features, and you understand the real challenges: latency, cost, reliability, evaluation, and graceful failure.
Comfortable without a playbook. You thrive where the problem isn't fully defined. You'd rather ship something useful this week and improve it than perfect it for a quarter. You measure yourself by whether the team is faster and more capable because of what you built, not by lines of code.

What You’ll Do

Embed and learn the domain. Sit with the team and build real fluency in how Finance runs across a multi-entity business spanning the US and Canada: the monthly close and its reconciliations, financial and management reporting, rebate accounting, AP/AR, and FP&A. This is the core of the job, not background context.
Build agents that automate real work. Find finance workflows that AI agents can handle or accelerate, then design, build, and ship them. For example, an agent that assembles the monthly close checklist and flags anomalies, or one that reconciles rebate flows end to end. Know where an agent earns its keep versus where a simple script is cheaper and more reliable.
Connect systems and keep data flowing. Much of the team's friction is manual handoffs between systems. You'll build and maintain integrations and automations that keep financial data flowing accurately between NetSuite, spreadsheets, and Jetson's data platform, so the numbers reconcile and reporting stops being a manual pull.
Build dashboards and tools. Give Finance and leadership clear, real-time visibility: margin by market and by job, cash position and AR/AP aging, budget-versus-actual, and a live view of where the close stands. Replace recurring hand-maintained spreadsheets with live dashboards and tools.
Always be scoping. Question requirements directly with the team. The best solution is often smaller than the original ask, or solves the real problem another way. Ship value now, iterate from there.
Generalize into the platform. Push reusable capabilities into the shared internal platform alongside other FDEs and core engineering, rather than piling up one-off scripts. Weigh hacking something for Finance today against building something ten teams use tomorrow.

How You Will Grow

Become a rare kind of engineer. Few people can connect a messy real-world domain, the data under it, and software people actually adopt. You'll build exactly that profile, which is one of the most valuable in the industry right now.
See the whole business. Embedded in Finance and plugged into the core platform, you'll understand how Jetson works end to end, with a front-row seat to the economics of the business. That makes you a stronger engineer and a sharper decision-maker.
Help define a new discipline at Jetson. We're early in understanding how AI changes what a small team can do. You'll set the patterns, platform, and standards for how forward deployed engineering works here.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: We are open to considering candidates at several levels. Our compensation is structured to meet or exceed the market standard.

Benefits:

Dental Care, Vision Care & Life Insurance premiums fully paid by Jetson
Extended Health Care
Disability Insurance
Education Support
Parental Leave Top Up
Equity

Work Location: In person - North Vancouver, BC

Do you feel like you don't have everything that's listed above but can still do the job? If you have the core skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply!

About the job
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About The Role

Our mission in the Brand pillar is to make it easy for Brands to create high-quality product listings on Faire, keep them up to date, and get them in front of retailers. Having access to well-curated catalogs of products lets Main Street retailers compete with big-box stores and we’re responsible for the first step in that journey.

As a Product Engineer on the Brand pillar, you will be responsible for planning and building features end-to-end, working alongside product, design, and data to achieve our mission.

You’re Excited About This Role Because…

You are excited about learning how our customers' businesses work, and what they need in order to succeed
You are entrepreneurial and data-driven, with a strong product sense
You effectively balance your excitement for building features with a focus on the long-term maintainability of those features
You want to use technology to help your local independent retailers and brands succeed
You want to experiment with the best AI productivity tools on the market to help accelerate customer impact

What You'll Do

Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and marketing to contribute significantly to the success of the business or the engineering platform
Identify and capitalize on new opportunities, overseeing complex multi-phase projects across multiple teams and platforms from concept to implementation
Build features across multiple stacks, potentially including Backend, Frontend, and Mobile
Optimize web applications for peak performance and scalability, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, fast, and scalable code
Mentor fellow engineers on both technical and product judgement

Qualifications

2+ years of experience
Proficient in at least one of Java, Kotlin, or JavaScript.
Comfortable in agentic coding tools
Familiar with HTML, CSS, Typescript, and frameworks/libraries like React, Next.js, etc.
Experience driving product improvements end to end, including deciding what problems are worth solving and how to solve them
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent industry experience
A love for technology, and an insatiable curiosity for new tools to solve real problems

Technologies We Use And Teach

Kotlin, Java, Javascript
JUnit, Hibernate, Guice, Jersey
React, NextJS
HTTP, JSON, and Protocol Buffers
MySQL, CockroachDB
AWS
